mechanics.claim: After hitting the first enemy, the bolt continues and can hit terrain or a second enemy, dealing the same damage and stunning both targets.
mechanics.quote: If the bolt hits terrain or a second enemy, it {{tip|stun|stuns}} both targets for the same duration, dealing the same damage to the secondary target.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield on the first target blocks the damage but the bolt still passes through, and can still stun/damage a second target.
mechanics.quote: If the first target has a spell shield, they will block the damage but the bolt will still pass through them.

mechanics.claim: If the second target has a spell shield, they block the stun and damage, but the first target is still stunned.
mechanics.quote: If the second target has a spell shield, they will block the stun and damage.

mechanics.claim: The stun still applies even if a target dies to the ability itself before the projectile can bind them.
mechanics.quote: The {{tip|stun}} is still applied even if the first or second target dies to the ability itself or before the projectile can bind them.
